name: Toggle
purpose: Turn one device or setting on or off.

elements.track: Visible pill. Smaller than the hit area.

behavior: The button element is the hit area (>= control.height.md); the track is what is drawn.
Pending: the thumb moves to the desired side immediately and shows a spinner until the device confirms.
On error or timeout the owner reverts aria-checked and reports why (desired vs reported, playbook 6.2).

a11y.notes: aria-checked reflects the desired state; aria-label names the device.

lvgl.notes: lv_switch with LV_STATE_CHECKED; pending is a custom state flag plus spinner.
